label: Procurement and Vendor Management Team
blurb: A Procurement Manager and 4 specialists who source suitable vendors and coordinate evaluation and ongoing obligations
purpose: Designed for business owners, leaders, and teams executing on procurement and vendor management. Source suitable vendors and coordinate evaluation and ongoing obligations. The team coordinates research, analysis, operational planning, and structured deliverables to drive measurable results.
